_doc: ALLDOMAINS-WPG-IMPL-1111 (plan work/ALLDOMAINS-1111 WP-G, which absorbs work/USFED-ROUTE-1111): the reviewed, release-pinned allow-list of permitted original HTML hosts for the generic ORIGINAL_HTML full-text route (vera/original_html.py, vera/fulltext_routes.py). A row grants access, so it lives in a reviewed policy file, never in the DB (OD-1110-LISTS-CONSENSUS). Read only by vera/original_html.py. The route claims a candidate only when its normalised URL has the row's exact host (https, port 443, no userinfo, no query, no fragment) and a path starting with one of the row's path_prefixes. LICENCE STATUS comes only from the row's licence_basis: wave 1 allows only 'us_federal_pd' (vera.gov_public_domain.decide on the FULL visible page text); 'page_declared' is NOT implemented and a row naming it is ignored (needs its own plan, licence review and C0 sample). Robots.txt (404/410 = no restriction; every other 4xx, 429, 5xx, timeout = fail closed), TDMRep, X-Robots-Tag, robots meta, Crawl-delay, the host_role 'store' check, the SSRF guard, a 401/403 access denial (never bypassed) and the rate portal run on every hop before and independent of this file. mode: off (ships; the route claims nothing) | shadow (runs the fetch, licence, extraction and admission steps, stores nothing, counts only) | on (stores, but only for rows with store: true).
_calibration_note: Every number in limits and extract is an UNCALIBRATED prior from work/USFED-ROUTE-1111/PLAN.md section 5.1 (steps 6-7). Real data behind the extract values: the 10 pilot pages saved by USFED-C0-1111 (5 energy.gov DOE Explains, 5 science.nasa.gov), leave-one-out measurement scratch/USFED-ROUTE-1111/c0b-loo.txt: max leakage L 0.023, F300 0 (thresholds L <= 0.05, F300 = 0). Spread: one sample, two hosts. Why these values: smallest settings that met the thresholds on that sample. What would change them: the per-row holdout of at least 10 pages per host drawn at random (plan G-B pass 12), shadow readout of pruned-character share per page. Each new row needs its own C0 and a third-party/contractor text sample before it may leave mode off. USFED-SHADOWFIX-1112 (plan section 5.6): limits.min_text_chars 1500 is measured on the stored converted text (len(text)), the only floor of this route, refused only as R-ACQ-ORIGINAL_THIN. Data: the 73 harvested DOE Explains pages (2026-11-12); on the 63 design pages len(text) is 2328-8411 after the section 5.6 tokens (margin 828 below the smallest); the converter's body_chars (744-3200, 23 below 1500) is NOT the measure, because it omits the lead text before the first h2. Spread: one host. Why 1500: a prior below every real explainer seen. The reject side is uncalibrated: no real thin or stub page was observed, and len(text) includes the title, headings and any leaked lines. What changes it: a real explainer under 1500 or a stub over it in the holdout or the shadow readout (a value change follows the threshold rule with a decision record). extract.drop_token_re gained field_banner_color, caption and attribution (section 5.6 SF-B), measured on the 63 DOE design pages (F300 > 0 on 20 -> 0 pages; newly pruned: captions, credits, the CMS banner-colour field, none with a heading) and on the 12 saved C0 pages of both hosts (no NASA line lost); a bare 'banner' is NOT used because it matches science.nasa.gov's title wrapper hds-page-intro-banner. USFED-FOLLOW-1112: field--label-visually_hidden added (drops the CMS hidden-label field wrapper, e.g. the sr-only Video Url label; on the 73 DOE and 6 NASA saved pages only the 2 Video Url lines are lost, no heading, no NASA line). Design-set effect only: the G-B holdout needs a fresh draw. Holdout result (G-B, 94f8658): 9 of 10 pages passed; doe-explainsultrafast-science failed F300 = 1 on the CMS Video Url label, which the field--label-visually_hidden token now drops; the holdout is therefore spent and a fresh holdout is required before any shadow or on decision. Full record: work/USFED-SHADOWFIX-1112/holdout-log.md.
_pre_on_condition: G-C condition for mode 'on' (ALLDOMAINS-WPG-IMPL-1111), enforced under PREON-ENFORCE-1112 in vera/original_html.py for mode 'on': the route claims and fetches only URLs present in the published index snapshot (exact snapshot membership), checked for the claim, the fetch, every redirect hop and the final URL. A missing, invalid or stale index refuses. A row's path_stems/path_prefixes alone never admit a URL that is absent from the snapshot.

snapshot._note: Vendored, reviewed catalogue snapshot (recorded divergence from feedback_no_hardcoded_data, work/USFED-ROUTE-1111 pass 2 ruling, conditions: runtime reads it and never writes it; it carries harvested_at, per-host robots status, script version and sha256; the later DB home is table permitted_catalogue (owner-gated DDL, not on the critical path); the divergence is entered in records/registers/ by the Clerk). Written only by the refresh script (WP-C), never at runtime.

rows._path_note: Whole-segment matching. DOE names explainer pages by appending the slug to the stem in ONE path segment (/science/doe-explainsneutrinos, read in USFED-C0-1111 and the plan), so this row uses path_stems: the stem plus a non-empty single-segment slug of lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, not starting with a hyphen. The bare stem (the index page) and anything deeper (/science/doe-explains-evil/x) never match.
